title: LTEST-002 SandMan Test UI Certificate Gate
contracts: Test=true is a local SandMan UI test setting, not a supporter certificate
the setting is read from Sandboxie.ini GlobalSettings Test
accepted true spellings are true yes y 1 and on
CSandMan::CheckCertificate returns true under the local UI test gate before showing the supporter-certificate QMessageBox
the local UI test gate must not mutate g_CertInfo or certificate parsing state
the local UI test gate must not change driver feature flags or core process enforcement
this local test entry is not an SREV and must not be included in the upstream-facing SREV/KPATH ledger
runtime_gate: Windows SandMan smoke with Sandboxie.ini [GlobalSettings] Test=true proving supporter-certificate warning dialogs are suppressed while driver feature enforcement remains owned by LTEST-001 core gates
